findings.title: Banked cycle-01 validation evidence contains fabricated MLX/MLX-C dylib hashes not derived from any actual bytes
findings.evidence: docs/architecture/reviews/evidence/f017-apple-production-serial-f32-execution-readiness-cycle-01-validation-v1.json records mlx_dylib_sha256=c30b247a597c69f40a6740f43e3033e00926a72838ffac20961ec06379e1a4ce and mlx_c_dylib_sha256=9882c904e860e968b70fdaeb6b722e871715a83f5c8a8cb164756312376871e5. Live rehash of /opt/homebrew/opt/mlx/lib/libmlx.dylib and /opt/homebrew/opt/mlx-c/lib/libmlxc.dylib yields c30b1529178de28d23817e6e73ea5133cf63af060379c41a27aa7420aa616b3d and 9882fe1f7ec1fcdb10cebde60e88b41826ab4dfed8ae624b99be419d6fa89561, matching runtime-rebind-v2 and the runner's compiled-in pins exactly. The evidence values share only a 4-hex-character prefix with the real hashes, appear nowhere else in git history (git log -S finds only commit 082dae1), match no Cellar artifact, and are produced by no committed tool: the repo validator whose PASS line the evidence quotes never hashes dylibs. The banked validation record therefore contains hand-transcribed or fabricated values in exactly the runtime-drift-detection surface this readiness package exists to freeze, so the evidence chain for cycle-01 validation is not mechanically derived and cannot be trusted as a record of what was measured. Enforcement-side artifacts (runtime-rebind-v2, wrapper-v3 preflight, runner pins) carry the correct hashes, so no unsafe execution path is opened, but a readiness package whose banked validation evidence asserts unmeasured values fails evidence integrity.
findings.required_action: Regenerate the execution-readiness validation evidence mechanically from actual rehashes (extend the validator to emit the dylib hashes it verifies, or bank the wrapper preflight's own measured output), commit the corrected evidence, and submit the corrected head for a fresh independent review cycle. No approval or GO may be issued against the 082dae1 evidence.

findings.title: wrapper-v3 validate_authority does not pin non-hash GO-token and approval fields to release constants
findings.evidence: Empirical probe: a synthetic token with checkpoint_reads=999, checkpoint_fallback=ALLOWED, allowed_stage_range=EVERYTHING, allowed_output_root=/tmp/evil, allowed_real_payload_consumption=999999 passed the field census, all thirteen hash bindings, and the approval-sha gate, reaching the human-approval gate; static reading of scripts/research/f017_apple_serial_f32_equivalence_wrapper_v3.py lines 127-162 confirms no gate examines checkpoint_reads, checkpoint_fallback, allowed_stage_range, allowed_output_root, allowed_real_payload_consumption, expected_starting_ledger, readiness_head, or the approval's reviewed_head/readiness_review_sha256 values. Not weakening today: the runner binary reads no token fields, has no checkpoint or shard interface, rejects unknown package fields, writes only to the package-pinned fixed_capture_root, and the package's checkpoint_paths must be empty; the poisoned fields are therefore dead values under the frozen code.
findings.required_action: Extend validate_authority to pin every remaining approval/token field to release constants: checkpoint_reads==0, checkpoint_fallback=='PROHIBITED', allowed_real_payload_consumption==0, expected_starting_ledger==175, allowed_stage_range=='input_hidden..production_s2', allowed_output_root==release.machine_local_paths.capture_root, and readiness_head/reviewed_head equal to the independently accepted readiness head.
findings.disposition: DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_NON_WEAKENING; exact bind point: wrapper-v3 revision plus code-manifest v3 update, landed and independently re-reviewed in the next readiness cycle, strictly before any human approval is signed or the operator-only GO generator is invoked.

findings.title: Success-path terminal hard-sets consumed_reads=0 and receipt_inventory=[] instead of deriving them from the receipts census
findings.evidence: scripts/research/f017_apple_serial_f32_capture_wrapper_v2.py terminalize_owned_success writes consumed_reads:0, receipt_inventory:[], ledger_after:175 as literals, while terminalize_owned_failure derives them from the payload-receipts directory. If receipts were ever present at success terminalization, the terminal would misstate accounting at write time and be caught only afterwards by the read-only reconciler (terminalizer v2 rejects TERMINAL_RECEIPT_COUNT_MISMATCH, TERMINAL_ORPHAN_INVENTORY_MISMATCH, TERMINAL_LEDGER_NOT_RECEIPT_DERIVED) and by same-commit master-ledger validation. Not weakening today: the runner has no payload-receipt-writing interface for this retained-only event, and the fail-closed reconciliation cross-check plus receipt-directory census remain the accounting authority, so the 175-to-175 zero-delta claim is receipt-cross-checked rather than trusted from terminal.json.
findings.required_action: Derive success-path consumed_reads, receipt_inventory, and ledger_after from the actual payload-receipts directory census and fail terminalization closed if the census is non-empty for this retained-only event.
findings.disposition: DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_NON_WEAKENING; exact bind point: same wrapper-v3/terminalization revision and code-manifest v3 update as F017-SF32-EXECREADY-C1-F2, independently re-reviewed before any live GO issuance.

findings.title: Ten-process determinism qualification is not executable under the frozen tooling and the release stop-boundary wording could be misread as covering it
findings.evidence: determinism-v2 correctly banks executed:false and representative_runs_this_phase:0, and the bound harness (f017_apple_serial_f32_ten_process_harness_v1.py, sha 5e9065c6) is deliberately inert: representative mode always exits with FUTURE_OPERATOR_WRAPPER_MUST_INJECT_TEN_DISTINCT_ONE_RUN_AUTHORIZATIONS. RN1 permits exactly one attempt at one fixed attempt root, the release budgets attempts=1, and the single-invocation runbook may be lifted only after independent ACCEPT of a successor contract, so no run-01..run-10 execution path exists in the reviewed bytes. However, release-v3 stop_boundary reads AFTER_APPLE_PRODUCTION_SERIAL_F32_CAPTURE_COMPARISON_AND_TEN_PROCESS_DETERMINISM_ONLY, which an operator could misread as this GO authorizing determinism runs. Not weakening: every determinism execution path fails closed today and no averaging or tolerance surface exists; byte-identity comparison and earliest-divergence reporting are correctly frozen in the contract and harness helper.
findings.required_action: The one authorized execution under this event is the single capture/comparison attempt only. The ten-fresh-process determinism qualification requires its own future release contract defining ten one-run authorizations and per-run attempt roots, with its own independent review; the current GO schema must not be construed to cover it.
findings.disposition: DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_NON_WEAKENING; exact bind point: the future determinism-execution release contract issued after the RN1 single-invocation runbook lift, which must restate the frozen byte-identity/no-averaging/no-tolerance rules and be independently reviewed before any determinism run.
